create_mlp_agent: create a baseline MLP agent with configurable hidden sizes, weight decay, and SGD steps
create_logistic_regression_agent: create a baseline logistic regression agent with configurable weight decay and adaptive scaling
run_logistic_regression_sweep: run a hyperparameter sweep over logistic regression configurations with varying weight decay and adaptive scaling
create_uniform_class_probs_agent: create a baseline agent that outputs uniform class probabilities regardless of input data
create_prior_agent: create a baseline agent that samples from the prior generative model MLP without using training data
